name: search_products
description: Search the shop's catalogue by name, brand, category or purpose. Use for any question about what is sold, what something costs, or whether it is in stock. Returns nothing if there is no match — say so rather than guessing.

request_body_schema.description: What the customer is looking for.

query.description: What the customer is after, in their own words: 'lunch box', 'Tupperware seals', 'something for rice'.

in_stock_only.description: Limit to items available now. Default false.
